lifecycle_exclusions.reason: Herb has documented emmenagogue, abortifacient, uterotonic (uterine stimulant), or teratogenic properties.
Herb or its toxic metabolites pass into breast milk and may harm the nursing infant.
Immature organ systems, metabolic pathways, and risk of severe toxicity or methemoglobinemia.
Heavy metal or potent alkaloid content contraindicated in young developing children.

lifecycle_exclusions.notes: Reduce all dosages by 50%. Avoid strong purgatives or central nervous sedatives.
